prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: one production-wide illustration for a literary Bible passage; requested canvas 1536x1024 pixels, landscape 3:2.
Primary request: Create one intimate springtime moment inspired by Song of Solomon 2:8–14. The beloved stands close beside a wooden lattice window, looking through it; her lover appears just beyond a low stone wall, calling to her. Spring flowers and fresh vine leaves show the season. These are open-ended poetic speakers, not a named historical couple or allegory.
Scene/backdrop: A modest garden dwelling and low courtyard wall in a timeless literary Levantine setting; use only the lattice, wall, flowers, vine, and fig leaves named in the poem.
Subject: Two clearly readable adult human faces and upper bodies: beloved near the lattice, lover visible just outside. The lover’s face and full visible figure must stay left of x=62% of the canvas. Put the beloved near x=20%, lover near x=50–55%; do not place any person or animal in the right third.
Style/medium: Realistic cinematic historical/literary illustration. Match the project references’ natural golden light, tactile woven cloth, wood, and limestone, grounded human scale, and restrained realism. Literary reconstruction, not documentary history.
Composition/framing: 3:2 wide landscape. Place all critical subjects, faces, and lattice between x=10% and x=62%. Leave the entire right 38% as quiet, low-detail courtyard wall and soft foliage for reader overlay. Keep top and bottom 12% noncritical. One continuous encounter, no montage or split panels.
Lighting/mood: Warm late-morning spring light, gentle shadows, tender and expectant without sensualized framing.
Color palette: Warm ochre, olive green, soft cream, dusty rose, restrained gold.
Materials/textures: Weathered lattice, limestone wall, woven adult clothing, young vine leaves and blossoms.
Constraints: Respectful adult figures; no nudity. The poem does not specify the couple’s appearance, date, or exact dwelling; do not imply a documented identity or site.
Avoid: Any text, letters, captions, labels, pins, UI, logos, watermark, modern objects, maps, animals, deity or God-in-human-form, religious iconography, exaggerated fantasy, empty landform diorama, unreadable text-like marks.
notes: Root inspected the full final raster and its named subjects. Hotspot coordinates were checked against the accepted image. Appearance and setting are illustrative; literary images are labeled in the reader.
